root.description:
The folder the notes are in. ~ is your home. Read as the shell starts. (The wiki's "Save to note" is wiki.jsonc "notesRoot".)

Takes a path. Default: "~/Documents/Notes". Read as the shell starts.

openAt.description:
What the popup opens on: "last" (where you left it, within a session) | "root" (the tiles) | "new" (a new note, the cursor in it).

Takes "last", "root" or "new". Default: "last".

escape.description:
Escape in an open note: "close" (the popup closes) | "back" (back to the tiles; Escape there closes).

Takes "close" or "back". Default: "close".

confirmDelete.description:
Deleting a note or a folder asks first (it goes to the trash either way). true | false.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

newName.description:
The name of a note that has none.

Takes a text like Untitled. Default: "Untitled".

linkClick.description:
A link is opened by "ctrl" (Ctrl+click; a plain click puts the cursor there) | "click".

Takes "ctrl" or "click". Default: "ctrl".
